name: Eating Pig
overview: Scripture clearly distinguishes the eating of pigs as forbidden for God's people, identifying swine as unclean because, despite having cloven hooves, they do not chew the cud (Leviticus 11:7). While God initially gave all moving creatures as food (Genesis 9:3), the Mosaic Law set apart His people by prohibiting the consumption of swine to maintain holiness (Leviticus 11:1). Furthermore, Isaiah warns that those who defile themselves by eating swine's flesh and other abominations will face judgment (Isaiah 66:17), underscoring the seriousness of obedience to God's commands in this matter.
